images.name: light-skoll-resting
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original Eitr Norse theme-carousel illustration, landscape16:9, requested3840x2160 or highest available. One FULL-BODY adult wolf LYING DOWN resting quietly on its belly, with forelegs/paws resting forward, rear legs tucked and long tail curled beside the body. Head lifted watchfully, three-quarter view, facing slightly toward the viewer so both glowing eyes can be seen. Show the ENTIRE animal including both ears, all visible paws, body, haunches and tail, comfortably within frame; absolutely not a portrait bust or standing wolf. The relaxed silhouette should resemble the compositional idea of a resting stag, but be anatomically a wolf. Centered balanced compact group: wolf in lower-middle, celestial disc above upper-middle with a clear small gap above its ears, all elements with generous breathing room. Sköll rests beneath a full round SUN floating above him, with warm fiery orange, golden-yellow and ember-red swirling solar surface texture, a restrained glowing corona and a few tiny prominences, inspired by the appearance of the Sun rather than a flat sun icon with straight rays. His two eyes glow the SAME rich orange/golden sunlight, clearly visible but no laser beams. Keep wolf fur palette strictly ash ivory #cacccc and #d9dbdc, slate #798186, charcoal #343d41 and near-black #101315/#080a0b. Use expressive hand-inked contours, broad simple planes of fur, two-tone cel shading and sparse dry-brush flecks, elegant restrained screenprint illustration, as simple as a charcoal/ivory drawn resting stag. The sun/moon can have richer painted surface texture and luminous halo, while the wolf stays drawn and simple. Light from the disc subtly touches the wolf's upper fur, without recoloring its entire body. No scenery, ground plane, landscape, stars, clouds, mountains, trees, ornaments, runic ring, crown, chains, lettering, logos, signatures, watermark, borders, UI, photograph or3D. Only the single resting wolf and the single celestial disc, TRANSPARENT background. Entire disc and halo comfortably in frame. New original composition; the celestial appearance is described in words, do not reproduce a source photo.
images.revision_prompt: Edit this illustration: replace ALL transparent background with a completely solid opaque BLACK #000000 background. No stars, no scenery, no ground, no fog or nature backdrop. Keep this exact FULL-BODY LYING-DOWN wolf, its ash ivory/charcoal/slate drawn fur, its pose and the fiery orange sun and matching glowing orange eyes. Reframe the group slightly smaller if needed so ALL paws, ears, tail and the complete celestial disc including its glow fit comfortably inside the canvas with black margins on all sides, especially above the disc. Place the disc above the wolf with a little black breathing space so it reads above, not a cut-off halo behind its ears. Keep the wolf simple and hand-drawn, the celestial texture richer and luminous. No added objects, lettering, logos, borders or watermark. Full-bleed landscape16:9, highest available resolution, OPAQUE solid black background; no alpha transparency.
